mapper.sql: SELECT q.*,(SELECT id FROM crm_sales_order s WHERE s.quotation_id=q.id AND s.deleted=0) AS order_id,(SELECT status FROM crm_sales_order s WHERE s.quotation_id=q.id AND s.deleted=0) AS order_status,(SELECT quotation_id FROM crm_sales_order s WHERE s.opportunity_id=q.opportunity_id AND s.status<>'CANCELLED' AND s.deleted=0) AS business_order_quote_id,(SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM crm_quotation v WHERE v.quote_no=q.quote_no AND v.deleted=0) AS latest_version_no,c.company_name AS current_customer_name,b.title AS opportunity_title,b.stage AS opportunity_stage,c.owner_id,o.dept_id AS owner_dept_id,o.real_name AS owner_name FROM crm_quotation q JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=q.customer_id JOIN crm_opportunity b ON b.id=q.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=c.owner_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_quotation q JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=q.customer_id JOIN crm_opportunity b ON b.id=q.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=c.owner_id
WHERE q.id=#{id} AND q.deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM crm_quotation WHERE quote_no=#{quoteNo} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM crm_quotation_item WHERE quotation_id=#{quotationId} ORDER BY sort_no,id
SELECT e.*,u.real_name AS actor_name FROM crm_quotation_event e JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=e.actor_id WHERE e.quotation_id=#{quotationId} ORDER BY e.id DESC

SELECT q.* FROM crm_quotation q JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=q.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=c.owner_id WHERE q.quote_no=#{quoteNo} AND q.deleted=0 AND c.owner_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY q.version_no
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_quotation SET is_final=0 WHERE opportunity_id=#{opportunityId} AND deleted=0 AND is_final=1
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM crm_quotation WHERE opportunity_id=#{opportunityId} AND deleted=0 AND is_final=1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.id FROM crm_product_sku s JOIN crm_product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE s.status=1 AND p.status=1 AND (s.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.model_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 100

SELECT id FROM crm_quotation WHERE deleted=0 AND customer_id=#{customerId} AND (status='ACCEPTED' OR (status='SENT' AND valid_until >= CURRENT_DATE)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_sales_order s WHERE s.quotation_id=crm_quotation.id AND s.status='COMPLETED' AND s.deleted=0) FOR UPDATE
SELECT version_no FROM crm_quotation WHERE quote_no=#{quoteNo} ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_sales_order WHERE quotation_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_quotation WHERE previous_id=#{id})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_sales_order WHERE quotation_id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND status<>'CANCELLED')
